description: Publish a compiled program for public access via /report

acl.description: Access control: public (anyone), authenticated (valid API key required), owner (owner's API key only), token (action_token required). Default: public

phi_override.description: Override PHI heuristic when the data owner has verified no field contains protected health information. Use when publish fails with 'PHI-tagged fields detected' but the flagged fields (e.g., 'location', 'audit', 'script') are not actually PHI. Default: false.

primary_file.description: Data file to load when running the report

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_publish
